local_review.finding_body: In tests/src/io.netty/netty-codec/5.0.0.Alpha1/src/test/java/io_netty/netty_codec/ClassLoaderClassResolverTest.java, both tests caught Error and accepted NativeImageSupport.isUnsupportedFeatureError even though the target class name is fixed, the class is included in the image, and the behavior does not require a class discovered after image build. This applies the sole open-ended dynamic-class-loading exception outside its permitted scope and could make the native tests pass without executing their assertions.
local_review.finding_title: Unsupported-feature catch masks statically available class resolution
local_review.fix_note: Approved after removing the two unsupported-feature catch blocks, their helper, and the now-unused NativeImageSupport import so the same class-resolution behavior and assertions must pass on JVM and Native Image. Both current-defaults and future-defaults-all native test lanes pass with the correction.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the complete local PR-equivalent diff, local gate evidence, and resolved statistics. The change is scoped to io.netty:netty-codec:5.0.0.Alpha1, replaces the unavailable ProtobufDecoderNano coverage with meaningful ProtobufDecoder coverage, uses only reachability-metadata.json, preserves assertions and native execution, and keeps index integrity. Overall dynamic access and the reflection breakdown both pass the ordered repair gate because coverage remains 100% (13/13 to 8/8). After the correction, checkMetadataFiles, compileTestJava, javaTest, checkstyle, and full current-defaults and future-defaults-all test lanes pass locally.
